findings.title: Force stop can kill an unrelated reused PID
findings.suggested_fix: Use a lifetime lock and verified process identity, or a retained OS process handle; refuse to signal when identity cannot be established.
evidence: tb-engine/crates/tb-cli/src/daemon.rs:144-151 explicitly describes the stale PID and reuse window.
tb-engine/crates/tb-cli/src/daemon.rs:483-512 reads the PID, tests only pid_alive, then escalates through SIGTERM and SIGKILL.

findings.title: Installer fallback aborts after replacing the adapter
findings.suggested_fix: Read the 2BRAIN_HOME environment key using a shell-compatible mechanism, then default an empty value to $HOME/.2brain.
evidence: install.sh:71 installs the adapter before install.sh:75 enters the engine-install failure fallback.

findings.title: Incremental edits suppress valid singular and plural search results
findings.suggested_fix: Treat dictionary terms with zero live postings as absent when resolving exact terms and word-form candidates, or remove empty entries during incremental removal.
evidence: tb-engine/crates/tb-engine/src/search.rs:917-919 documents that removing the last posting retains the dictionary entry.
tb-engine/crates/tb-engine/src/search.rs:1257-1261 returns the dead exact term before trying word_forms; search.rs:1363-1369 uses incremental remove and add on an edited note.

findings.title: Internal rejections defeat bounded stdio backpressure
findings.suggested_fix: Route internal rejections through the same permit-acquiring, bounded-wait send path as normal responses.
evidence: tb-mcp-rs/src/bounded_stdio.rs:148-154 acquires and forgets a semaphore permit for normal sends, while 181-198 queues internal rejections directly.
tb-mcp-rs/src/bounded_stdio.rs:112-116 returns a semaphore permit for every queued message, regardless of whether one was acquired.
tb-mcp-rs/src/bounded_stdio.rs:158-173 applies the outbound wait only once before the loop, so a blocked internal rejection can also bypass that timeout.
